notes.content:

notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
[h3] The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. [/h3]

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with [b]Boti: Byteland Overclocked - Deluxe Edition[/b] and many other titles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png[/img]

🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, [b]we're pledging 20% of our net profits to Whale and Dolphin Conservation[/b] and you get to purchase our games, Boti: Byteland Overclocked - Deluxe Edition included, at [i]deep[/i] discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟

[previewyoutube=7TmAZSZtikA;full][/previewyoutube]

 [h2][b]About Boti: Byteland Overclocked - Deluxe Edition[/b][/h2]

Play as Boti, a data robot sent into the computer world of Byteland to rid it of bugs, viruses, and glitches. Take on a world full of advanced automation and computing processes brought colorfully to life. Use your powers to solve puzzles, fight digital threats and conquer complex platforming sections. Dive into a classic 3D platformer experience solo or team up with a friend in seamless co-op.

Deluxe Edition includes:
[list]
[*]Boti: Byteland Overclocked

[*] Boti: Byteland Overclocked: Click or Treat DLC:
 expand your adventures into a newly discovered island within the central HUB area, unlocking portals to three spine-chilling, spooky levels.
 
[*] Boti: Byteland Overclocked: Hidden Giftware DLC:
 winter has come to Byteland with 5 new winter island levels. Skate and slide your way into this new chilly chapter filled with slippery challenges all around the HUB area.
 
[*] Boti: Byteland Overclocked - Bitosaurus DLC:
the ultimate clash between Dinos and Robots continues - grab a special skin, unleash your inner Dino and rawr your way through Byteland!

 Boti: Byteland Overclocked Soundtrack:
immerse yourself in the world of Byteland with this musical masterpiece: from tunes infused with creative arcade elements to magnetic gameplay sounds of a world full of advanced automation and computing processes.

[*]Boti: Byteland Overclocked Artbook
an exclusive behind-the-scenes glimpse into the characters, setting, insights, and the expansive world of 'Boti: Byteland Overclocked - explore the creative process behind this unique blend of platforming and fresh innovation

[*]Boti: Byteland Overclocked Coloring Book
whether you're passionate about color palettes, eager to channel your inner Renaissance painter, or simply want to design a color-vibrant skin for Boti - the iconic characters and locations are waiting for you to bring them to life!

[*]Boti: Byteland Overclocked - Bit Racing DLC
Ready to take your Byteland adventures to the next gear? The Bit Racing DLC is here, bringing you stylish hovercraft customizations!
Head to the Hovercraft Island in the Hub and check out your shiny new garage! Here, you’ll find 15 unique hovercraft skins available for purchase using in-game currency (files). Want your hovercraft to stand out on the track? We’ve got you covered with styles to fit every racer!
🏁 Ready. Set. Overclock! 🏁
[/list]

[h3]Need more wacky action? Check out [b]Boti: Bytland Overclocked + Metamorphosis bundle[/b]!
[/h3]
[*]Boti: Byteland Overcloked is a throwback to the classic 3D platformers of the past. Explore the inside of a computer and defeat the bugs, viruses and glitches found within. Fight solo or in co-op with a friend with seamless drop-in, drop-out gameplay! Solve puzzles and test your jumping skills in challenging platforming sections. Take a byte out of cybercrime!

[*]In Metamorphosis, you are Gregor, a man who wakes up and finds he has mysteriously been transformed into a bug. Use your new body to traverse this dark and twisted world and head towards The Tower, where you may find the answers you seek. How you did you end up like this? Why has your friend Joseph been arrested? Why does garbage taste so good? Maybe not that last one, but Gregor has some things to work out.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38144/Boti_Byteland_Overclocked__Metamorphosis/

notes.title: Boti: Byteland Overclocked Patch 1.14 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Bytelanders! 🌍
We've been hard at work squashing bugs and improving your adventure. Here's what's fixed in the latest update:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43041015/becfb9b8f477100570be0f7f983b0bd65be12d85.png[/img]

[b]Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*] The Speed Demon achievement unlocks correctly now.
[*] The Influencer achievement unlocks correctly now.
[/list]

[b]Hovercraft-Related Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Hovercraft performance on the Hub has been optimized to reduce lag.
[*] Fixed a rare crash when entering Level 4 with the Bit Racing DLC active.
[*] Hovercraft levers no longer spawn excessive hovercrafts.
[*] The player camera shaking issue has been resolved when the host bumps into obstacles while using a hovercraft.
[/list]

[b]Byteland Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Joining a game after beating the [spoiler]Trojan Horse[/spoiler] no longer disrupts game flow.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where platforms lacked collision at the end of Level 1.
[*] The first tutorial upload point no longer causes lag.
[*] Returning to the Hub no longer triggers Coulombot's commentary on Kernel's tape unexpectedly.
[*] Gamepad vibrations are now active and functional during gameplay.
[*] Ladybug trampolines now work properly for players.
[*] The player now teleports in front of Boti's house after finishing the tutorial with the host.
[*] The player's camera no longer falls through water under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed a rare issue preventing the player from defeating the [spoiler]Magnetic Spider.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[b]Visual and Audio Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The Halloween Confusion effect visuals no longer persist after the effect ends.
[*] Multiple audio tweaks have been implemented for improved sound quality and consistency.
[*] Regular Data Files no longer flicker for players after being collected.
[*] The Shredder obstacles now loop their sound properly.
[*] Sliding double sounds have been fixed (rare issue).
[/list]

Thank you for your continued feedback and support! 
Let us know your thoughts on the update and report any new issues. 

See you in Byteland! 💜

[hr][/hr]

 [list]

[*]         Resolved multiple combat issues with Fiery Glitcher.

[*]         Summary Screen bar now fills completely if you manage to snag more files than required for a 3-star score - overachievers rejoice!
[*]         Implemented small optimization & performance adjustments for a smoother gaming experience.
[*]         Fixed the replication issue with breakable platforms.
[*]         Introduced distinct HUD color schemes for Host and Client, for a more personalized touch.

notes.content:
Thank you all for playing and enjoying our demo.

But most importantly, thanks for sharing your feedback!

Today we're rolling out an update for our demo, which should let you enjoy it more.

What has changed?

- **Movement Tutorial added** - Boti has some moves, but some of you could feel a bit lost at the beginning of the game. We added a tutorial to help you out with your first jumps in Byteland.
- **Optimization:** We know you need a crispy running game, and with this update, you should see slight improvement in Boti's performance (demo is capped at 60 FPS)
- **UX improved** - you should see more clearly where players' action is required
- **Inverted Controls** added to the settings.
- **When your coop partner joins mid-level all objects should properly load**
- **Light effect on spinning reactor fixed in low and high graphics setting**
- **The water stopped flashing in a low-quality graphics setting**
- **Shadows behave better in low quality settings ("black walls")
- Now that's meta-gaming: A game about saving a cyber world from bugs and viruses gets a whole bunch of minor bug fixes

Please share your feedback and help us improve Boti's adventures

If you like our game don't forget to wishlist!
